title: When the Current Wakes
author: Lena Yarrow
blurb: Hazel Sandoval, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
